# region imports
from AlgorithmImports import *
# endregion

class EquityDonchianBreakoutAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    def initialize(self) -> None:
        self.set_start_date(2022, 1, 1)
        self.set_end_date(2024, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(100000)

        # automatic_indicator_warm_up only supports automatic indicators, not manual indicators.
        self.settings.automatic_indicator_warm_up = True

        self._spy = self.add_equity("SPY", Resolution.MINUTE)

        # 3-day price min/max for donchian breakout detection
        self._donchian = DonchianBreakout(3, 3)
        # Alternatively, use a manual indicator.
        # self._donchian = DonchianBreakout(3, 3)
        # self.warm_up_indicator(self._spy.symbol, self._donchian, Resolution.DAILY)
        # self.register_indicator(self._spy.symbol, self._donchian, Resolution.DAILY)

        # ATR based trend filter
        self._atr = AverageTrueRange(14)
        # Alternatively, use a manual indicator.
        # self._atr = AverageTrueRange(14)
        # self.warm_up_indicator(self._spy.symbol, self._atr, Resolution.DAILY)
        # self.register_indicator(self._spy.symbol, self._atr, Resolution.DAILY)

        self.plot_indicator("Donchian", self._donchian)

        self.schedule.on(
            self.date_rules.every_day(self._spy.symbol),
            self.time_rules.after_market_open(self._spy.symbol, 1),
            self._rebalance
        )

    def _rebalance(self) -> None:
        if not self._donchian.is_ready or not self._atr.is_ready:
            return

        price = self._spy.price
        if not self._spy.holdings.is_long:
            self.plot("Entry", "SPY", price)

        # Exit on break of donchian band
        if price < self._donchian.upper_band[-1] * 0.95:
            self.liquidate(self._spy.symbol)
            self.plot("Exit", "SPY", price)
        elif price > self._donchian.lower_band[-1] * 1.05:
            self.set_holdings(self._spy.symbol, 1.0)
            self.plot("Entry", "SPY", price)
